newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai raises stake in two units.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai raises stake in two units.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to raise its stake in China C & Y International Holdings Ltd and China Assets (Holdings) Ltd for a total of HK$61.76 million.

First Shanghai said it agreed to buy 33.33 percent of China C & Y from parent International Enterprises Investment Co Ltd for HK$28.38 million cash, making China C & Y a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company.
International Enterprises holds 35.44 percent of First Shanghai.

First Shanghai also said it would buy 8.24 million China Assets shares from International Enterprises for HK$33.38 million, raising its stake in the investment company to 16.7 percent from 5.6 percent.
First Shanghai said the purchase would be paid for by an issue of 41.73 million new shares at HK$0.80 each.
International Enterprises' stake in First Shanghai would be increased to 39.08 percent from 35.44 percent following the deal, it said.

China C & Y has an investment portfolio of equity interests in joint ventures in China involved in plastic injection moulding, cosmetics, and the manufacture and distribution of sanitary ware, ceramic tiles, granite and marble.
China Assets invests in Chinese joint ventures which engage in the manufacture of cement, steel, glass and plastic products, chemical and construction materials, and pharmaceuticals.
Shares of First Shanghai were up HK$0.02 at HK$0.89 in late morning trade on Monday.
